line: A traveller crosses the world one full-bleed screen print at a time, a ticket stub counting the distance from home, until the far side turns into the way back.
line_cn: 一张满屏丝印海报一座城，票根数着离家的公里数，走到世界的另一头，才发现那是回家的路。

labels: Condensed display for names and values (e.g. Big Shoulders Display, League Gothic), auto-fit; a geometric sans for letter-spaced labels (e.g. Outfit 600).
Headers are printed into the sky, tracked out; the info band is printed last.
The poster text is the subtitle. No narration is needed; if there is a voice, subtitles are a printed strip (a band pull), never a floating caption.
Reading rule: each text stays ≥ chars/12 + 1 s (min 1.5 s) after its last item lands, and ≥ max(1.8 s, speech + 0.6 s) with a voice. Compute it from the content, round up to the beat.
motion: Pulls are linear and steady (a squeegee does not ease). Accent inks start half a beat after the main ink of their layer.
Info items print left to right on subdivisions of the beat. There is no fade anywhere.
Screen lift: the frame hinges up (vertical squash + growing shadow) in ~0.4 s.
Palette re-ink: a wide squeegee travels diagonally over the sheet in ~0.35 s; geometry identical on both sides of the blade, only the inks change. Show only the blade, bead and a sliver of handle.

native_moves.name: One ink, one beat
native_moves.does: Facts print last, when they are read.
native_moves.fits: museum hours; a ferry timetable; tasting notes.

native_moves.name: Split fountain
native_moves.does: Several inks in one pull fill the frame with colour.
native_moves.fits: a festival's night sky; a sunset beach bar; a rainbow of colourways.

native_moves.name: Palette re-ink
native_moves.does: Same poster, another palette = time passing, a season, a variant.
native_moves.fits: summer vs winter hours; three jacket colourways; day and night at a market.

native_moves.name: Registration slip → snap
native_moves.does: Loose layers clamp into register with one hit, before the key facts.
native_moves.fits: the date of a race; a launch price; a ticket sale opening.

native_moves.name: Paper as a colour
native_moves.does: The unprinted sheet is the brightest element.
native_moves.fits: a ski slope; a lighthouse beam; fresh snow on a roof.

native_moves.name: The route as a printed layer
native_moves.does: A dashed accent line stamped segment by segment.
native_moves.fits: a bus line; a marathon course; a delivery path.

native_moves.name: The series wall
native_moves.does: Every print ends up hung together as the final lockup.
native_moves.fits: a city's four districts; a band's tour dates; a product family.
